text_block_list.text:
Well now, truly magnificent! You showed me 
your skills loud and clear, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well now, truly magnificent! You showed me 
your skills loud and clear, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Looking at it up close like this 
makes it look even cuter, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, is it really okay for me to take 
this?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'll pay you back with my running, 
so keep your hopes high!
